purpose: Test zero-refit transfer of the frozen Qwen2.5-7B duration-augmented Token-Energy model from GPU index 0 to the second physical GH200 in the same node.

target_device.relation_to_source: second physical device of the same SKU in the same node
target_device.energy_scope: target GPU board only; NVML scope-0 instantaneous-power integral
target_device.co_run_policy: both physical GPUs must be free of model allocations before every target-device attempt
target_device.device_uuid_policy: private raw provenance; not frozen in this public contract

transfer_hypothesis.equation: E_token = intercept + alpha_weight * weight_decimal_GB_per_token + beta_kv * kv_read_write_decimal_GB_per_token + p_time_W * decode_seconds_per_useful_token
transfer_hypothesis.primary_unit_of_analysis: cell mean over five independent target-device runs

claim_policy.passing_result: supports zero-refit transfer across two physical devices of one GH200 SKU in one pinned software stack
claim_policy.failing_result: rejects same-SKU device transfer while preserving the source-device result
not_authorized: causal interpretation of p_time_watts as literal idle power
advance prediction without a separately supplied duration predictor
